CustomField.description: When checked, every call waits for a human decision before the tool runs. When unchecked, the tool runs unless the agent's authorization policy denies it or asks for approval. Execution Safety never adds approval.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check to have the Approver Type approve every call before it runs. Unchecked, calls wait for approval only when the agent's authorization policy asks, and still go to the Approver Type. Only agents with an execution identity can use approvals.
CustomField.label: Always Require Approval
